source: ZymoBIOMICS Microbial Community Standard (D6300), theoretical composition by 16S rRNA gene copy number, from the manufacturer's product sheet (https://www.zymoresearch.com/products/zymobiomics-microbial-community-standard), checked 2026-08-12. The two yeasts of the standard (Saccharomyces cerevisiae, Cryptococcus neoformans) are omitted: they do not amplify with 16S primers.
notes: Synonyms follow the nomenclature of SILVA 138.1 and NCBI (Limosilactobacillus; Escherichia-Shigella merged at genus rank). Species that the V3-V4 region cannot separate from their neighbours (Escherichia coli / E. fergusonii, Bacillus subtilis / B. mojavensis) are NOT treated as synonyms, so a call to the neighbour counts as a false positive and a miss; the scoring is deliberately strict.
